description: Microsoft 365 hooks: a permissionDecision 'ask' gate on the outward-facing writes (send an email draft, discard a draft, create a calendar event with invitations, send, start or edit a Teams message, delete a message or your own Teams message, create a sharing link, attach a file to a draft (and save a pasted chat image for it), point the plugin at credential files). A second matcher routes teams_stage to the same script, which stays silent unless the message carries attachments (then it saves pasted images, resolves real paths and shows the files). The list lives in data/tools.json under 'confirm'; a test keeps this matcher in step with it. The wrapper fails closed: if the check script or Python is missing it asks the human instead of allowing silently.

hooks.command: ask() { printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Microsoft 365: the confirmation check could not run, so please confirm this change yourself."}}'; }; s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_write_confirm.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || { ask; exit 0; }; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] && continue; [ $r -eq 0 ] && exit 0; ask; exit 0; done; ask; exit 0

ask() { printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Microsoft 365: the confirmation check could not run, so please confirm this change yourself."}}'; }; s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_write_confirm.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || { ask; exit 0; }; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] && continue; [ $r -eq 0 ] && exit 0; ask; exit 0; done; ask; exit 0
